svg.font-family: Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Flying through a Talbot carpet
svg.desc: Animation: a cursor sweeps through the Talbot carpet behind a 100 nm grating (25 percent open) at 13.5 nm, its intensity profile drawn at right; it pauses where the period halves, where the image shifts by half a period and at the Talbot length, then a gap average becomes the half-period DTL image.
svg.text: TALBOT CARPET · 100 NM AMPLITUDE GRATING · 13.5 NM · ±10 ORDERS, EXACT PROPAGATION
I(x, z) behind the grating (25 % open), y = 0; brightness = intensity
distance behind the grating z (zᵀ = 1475 nm exact for the ±1 orders; 2p²/λ = 1481 nm paraxial)
